answer: A juror that skips cases loses 25% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Because the kernel decay is applied at each close, the ripple audit exposes the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool as a result watches its influence decay while paying the sonnet fee to keep them eligible. Honest users pay that once, farms 36 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
